Package aor.proj3t.resource

Class MessageResource

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.resource.MessageResource
@Path("/messages") @RequestScoped @Produces("application/json") @Consumes("application/json") public class MessageResource extends Object
REST endpoint for message-related operations. This class handles requests for sending, receiving and managing messages between users.

      Send a new message to another user

      @GET @Path("/conversation/{otherUserId}") @Produces("application/json") public jakarta.ws.rs.core.Response getConversation(@HeaderParam("Authorization") String authHeader, @PathParam("otherUserId") Long otherUserId, @QueryParam("page") int page, @QueryParam("pageSize") int pageSize)
      Get messages between the authenticated user and another user (conversation)
      Parameters:
      authHeader - The authorization header containing the JWT token
      otherUserId - The ID of the other user in the conversation
      page - Page number for pagination (default: 0)
      pageSize - Number of messages per page (default: 50)
      Returns:
      Response containing the list of messages
